title: Feasibility and Tolerability Study of Smart Contact Lens With Healthy Subjects and Patients With Stargardt's Disease
official: Feasibility and Tolerability Study of Wearing a Miniaturized Smart Contact Lens With Healthy Subjects and Patients With Stargardt's Disease
summary: Oculometry is becoming increasingly popular in fields such as enhanced reality and healthcare, but remains limited by complex devices that are poorly adapted to the needs of users, particularly the visually impaired. This research proposes to explore a smart contact lens (SCL)-based system to overcome these limitations, particularly for people with central visual deficits such as Stargardt's disease.
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier National d'Ophtalmologie des Quinze-Vingts
